**Source:** generator: TC-25's run, killed at step 1,200 (60%)
**Expected:** evaluation rows for steps 100–1,200 (12 rows) are intact; s000, s025 and s050 load; nothing later exists · **Tolerance:** exact

**Pipeline:** PL-11 · **Covers:** QR-03, AD-13 · **Kind:** synthetic known-answer · **Fixture:** tests/fixtures/learn/TC-27/

**Skills:** null-hypothesis-testing

**Pipeline:** PL-11 · **Covers:** POLICY-04, QR-01 · **Kind:** model evaluation · **Fixture:** tests/fixtures/learn/TC-35/
**Source:** POLICY-04; settings `configs/tank/ppo-single.toml`, seed 1
**Expected:** mean survival seconds beats both baselines (`learn.beats`, Tank family size 4); wall clock ≤ 3,600 s · **Tolerance:** α = 0.05 corrected
**Skills:** null-hypothesis-testing

**Pipeline:** PL-11 · **Covers:** POLICY-05, QR-01 · **Kind:** model evaluation · **Fixture:** tests/fixtures/learn/TC-36/
**Source:** POLICY-05; settings `configs/tank/ppo-school.toml`, seed 1

All four test plans and their fixtures are written. `dt lint` shows 0 errors (only the 3 known `dataviz` warnings). In `dt status`, the only gap is PL-18 (the chart command), which has no golden case because you chose smoke-only. Everything is still Draft.

There are 49 cases, TC-01–TC-49. Every pipeline has a smoke test, and the fixtures total about 400 KB, mostly folder overhead.

**What the expected outputs are based on:** you had no trusted input/output pairs, so every expected output comes from one of these. None came from running a script:
- an exact result from the rules or maths (closed form),
- an example worked in the spec's acceptance criteria,
- a seeded generator plus a property that must hold.

**worlds** (PL-07–PL-10). All exact unless a tolerance is shown.
| ID | Case | Expected | Tolerance |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-01 | Snake eats; turns are relative to heading | head (6,5), length 4, score 1, not over; heading N + left → head moves west | exact |
| TC-02 | Hits wall | over, not truncated | exact |
| TC-03 | Hits own body, but not the tail it vacates | body case → over; tail case → not over, head (5,4) | exact |
| TC-04 | Hunger limit | 99th step not over; 100th step over and truncated | exact |
| TC-05 | Greedy baseline | body to the east → straight or right; boxed in → straight | exact |
| TC-06 | Compact view | `[1,0,0, 0,0,0,1, 1,0,0,1]`; full view has 104 values | exact |
| TC-07 | Same seed gives the same episode, all 3 worlds | the two runs are bitwise equal | exact |
| TC-08 | Head-on bounce | velocity (−1, 0), speed 1, radius ≤ 0.92 | 1e-9 |
| TC-09 | Oblique bounce | speed 1; normal component flips, tangential unchanged | 1e-9 |
| TC-10 | Speed cap and wall | speed ≤ 0.8, radius ≤ 0.96 | 1e-9 |
| TC-11 | Caught fish leaves | fish_0 done and gone; the other 7 active; not over | exact |
| TC-12 | Tank score (spec example 10, 20, 60 s) | 30 | 1e-9 |
| TC-13 | Sight radius 0.5 | ball at 0.6 hidden, 0.4 visible, single setting always visible; hidden slot zeroed | exact |
| TC-14 | Flee baseline | ball behind → (1, 0); no ball → (0, 0) | 1e-6 |
| TC-15 | Start distance, seeds 0–99 | every fish ≥ 0.5 from the ball | exact |
| TC-16 | Pellets and catches | pellet eaten → +1 and still 10 pellets; two prey caught in one step | exact |
| TC-17 | Hunt score (spec example) | predator 3, prey 3 | 1e-9 |
| TC-18 | Speed ratio and sight | predator top speed ≤ 1.2 × prey's; 0.6 hidden, 0.4 visible | 1e-9 |
| TC-19 | Scripted predator and prey | each steers toward its target (nearest prey, centre, pellet) or directly away from the predator | turn direction by sign |
| TC-20 | Benchmark | ≥ 5,000 steps/s per world | threshold |

**learn** (PL-11–PL-14)
| ID | Case | Expected | Tolerance and why |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-21 | Lookup table on the 2-state chain, γ 0.9 | Q*(A,stay) 0.81, (A,fwd) 0.9, (B,stay) 0.9, (B,fwd) 1.0 | 1% relative, the learner sanity bar |
| TC-22 | Value network on the same chain | same Q* | 5% relative, for approximation noise |
| TC-23 | Policy learner, reward −(a − 0.5)² | mean action 0.5; every action in [−1, 1] | ±0.1, for gradient noise |
| TC-24 | Shared school policy | 1 parameter set, and its batched actions match the logged ones | exact |
| TC-25 | Run folder | 20 evaluations at steps 100–2,000, 5 snapshots, a row per episode | exact |
| TC-26 | Run interrupted at 60% | 12 evaluations; s000, s025, s050 present; s075 and s100 absent | exact |
| TC-27 | Reproducibility | the two runs' evaluation scores are bitwise equal | exact |
| TC-28 | Seed guard | 1,000,000 → `ValueError`; 999,999 accepted; evaluation seeds 1,000,000–1,000,099 | exact |
| TC-29 | Deterministic evaluation | the two evaluations are identical | exact |
| TC-30 | Alternating rounds | predator, prey, predator, prey; round 1 against untrained prey; ≥ 5 snapshots per side | exact |
| TC-31 | Opponent pool | 40–60% of episodes against the current opponent | the band from COEV-11 |
| TC-32 | Tournament | a 5×5 table; each cell is the mean of its 100 per-seed scores; 25 CSV rows | 1e-12 |
| TC-33–36 | Model evaluations | Snake DQN beats random and scripted in ≤ 1 h; lookup table beats random; single fish and school beat both in ≤ 1 h | α 0.05 corrected; the `null-hypothesis-testing` skill |

**lab** (PL-15–PL-21)
| ID | Case | Expected | Tolerance and why |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-37 | Planted gap (means 10 vs 8, paired, seed 11) | passes | α 0.05, family of 3; the skill |
| TC-38 | Pure noise, seeds 12–31 | ≤ 1 of 20 passes | from α; the skill |
| TC-39 | Identical scores | not passed, p 1.0 | exact |
| TC-40 | Hunt agents vs scripted agents (COEV-07, COEV-08) | both pass | α 0.05, family of 4; the skill |
| TC-41 | Co-evolution (COEV-05, COEV-06) | both pass; each run ≤ 1 h | α 0.05, family of 4; the skill |
| TC-42 | Note with 1 break-it and no prediction | {`too-few-breakit`, `missing-prediction`} | exact |
| TC-43 | Complete note after refresh | no problems | exact |
| TC-44 | Refreshing twice | second refresh changes 0 blocks; prose byte-identical | exact |
| TC-45 | Hand-edited number in a results block | exactly one `stale-results` | exact |

**compare** (PL-22)
| ID | Case | Expected | Tolerance |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-46 | Ratio check | 8.0/10.0 → 0.8, pass; 7.9/10.0 → 0.79, fail | 1e-12 |
| TC-47 | Reference mean of 0 | `ValueError` | exact |
| TC-48 | Adapter return equals world score | equal; 104 observation values, 3 actions | exact |
| TC-49 | Snake: hand-written vs library | hand mean ≥ 0.8 × reference mean | the 0.8 threshold, no slack |

**Assumptions I made:**
- **Snake coordinates:** x runs right and y runs down, so north is y − 1. The tail cell is vacated in the same step the head moves.
- **Compact-view order:** danger [straight, left, right], heading [N, E, S, W], food [up, down, left, right].
- **Fish turning:** a positive turn is counter-clockwise.
- **Test-only worlds:** `chain2` and `bandit1` are small worlds that the build writes under `tests/`. They are never registered in the real code.
- **Step budgets:** 20,000 steps for TC-21–23 is my estimate. The tester may raise it, but never loosen a tolerance.
- **Results blocks in notes** close with a `<!-- /results -->` marker.
- **Hour-long cases** (TC-20 and TC-33–36, 40, 41, 49) are marked `slow` or `perf`. They run by hand at each stage's exit, not in CI.

**Open questions:**
- PL-15, PL-17 and PL-18 have smoke tests only, as you chose.
- The Tank and Hunt library comparisons get their own cases when S2 and S3 are planned.

**Requirements with no golden case:**
- The replay, chart and train commands are smoke-only: REPLAY-01–07, TRAIN-05, LAB-03 and COEV-09.
- COEV-10's two break-it runs are covered by the lab notes' structure checks, not by a number.
- QR-02 (no GPU) and QR-04 (frame rate) are checked by step unit tests.

Do you approve these expected outputs? Once you do, I'll mark the four `tests.md` files Approved and move on to `build-planning`.
